item.title: Hantavirus: Media Hoax or Covid 2.0?
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes takes a look at what could be the next scamdemic: Hantavirus. Media reports have wildly blown the illness out of proportion. Does the World Health Organization really think people will fall for a new Covid 2.0? Or is this just a blip on the radar? Join guests Nurse Nicole, host of America Out Loud Radio, and Dr. Meryl Nass, a biological epidemiologist to discuss Hantavirus and the future of potential pandemics.

item.title: Trump’s Endorsement: The golden seal that holds the key to victory
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes discusses the power of the Trump Endorsement. US President Donald Trump is now 8-0 in his endorsements of GOP candidates and is fresh off a major victory of Thomas Massie in Kentucky’s 4th District. So, is Trump the undisputed king of the GOP, and will an opposition America First movement ever take off? Joining Scottie for this discussion are Garland Nixon, political and geopolitical analyst, and Scott Stantis, cartoonist for the Chicago Tribune.

item.title: The collapse of American Democracy: Redistricting wars
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes delves into the dark and twisted world of gerrymandering and the recent redistricting wars throughout the US. A very close vote in Virginia has recently given Democrats several new seats in Congress. This is in response to similar moves in states like Texas by Republicans. So, is there any sense of honoring democracy in the US, or is Congress just one big battleground between the Democrats and Republicans? Scottie also starts out the show with a personal word on the recent shooting attempt at the White House Correspondent's Dinner. Larry Ward, Chairman of Constitutional Rights PAC, and Nate Chessis, Campaign Manager & Surrogate to Eugene Yu for Congress, join the show.

item.title: Lack of accountability: Why do members of Congress get away with the unthinkable?
item.description: Eric Swalwell is out of Congress and no longer in the running for governor of California. But a new bombshell report shows there are 27 other congressional members who have sexual misconduct accusations against them. So, why has there been so little accountability? And why are we finding out about this now? On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by Miami Republican Committeewoman Angie Wong and Michael Wynne, Former US assistant attorney. Don’t miss this discussion as we explore term limits for Congress and the possibility of background checks for elected representatives.

item.title: Representative Tim Burchett: What the government doesn’t want you to know about UFOs
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes has the honor of being joined by Tennessee Republican Representative Tim Burchett. Rep. Burchett talks about a lifelong passion of his – revealing the truth about UFOs. As a member of several House committees, Rep. Burchett has insider information about just what has been going on with all of the recent reports of flying craft hovering above US bases and war planes. He believes the American people are being lied to. Don’t miss this episode of America First !

item.title: Belief, reverence, and the church: When faith and politics meet
item.description: What role does faith and belief have in politics? In the United States it is a major factor. Evangelicals have convinced themselves that a war in Iran is a Holy War, one written about in the scriptures. Add to that the strength of the Israel lobby, and we are looking at apocalyptic end times. Joining Scottie Nell Hughes on this episode of America First are Jake Shields, former champion fighter and prominent podcaster, and legal and media analyst Lionel. Don’t miss it!
